messages:
Alice (runtime): Quick dump from today's scheduling-latency replay harness run. Ran three configs: baseline, adaptive-batcher, kv-aware. Posting short notes + perf-bot summary.
Ben (mlinfra): Nice — apples-to-apples check: same model/tokenizer across runs?
Alice (runtime): Yes — nllama-13b, tokenizer v2, deterministic seeds. Replay uses prod traces (7d) not synthetic.
Dinesh (sre): Noted. Did the replay include multi-tenant interleaving? That's where queueing fairness shows up.
Alice (runtime): Yep, traces preserved tenant IDs and arrival timestamps. Important find: batch cap + max_delay interaction caused tenant C tail outsized.
Carla (infra): KV cache numbers? Was there a cold-miss storm during ramp?
Alice (runtime): Global KV hitrate ~82% normally. Tenant C dropped to 55% during ramp because of aggressive 15s TTL + uneven shard assignment. We saw repeated KV regen and higher token compute.
Ben (mlinfra): Concrete latency numbers please (p50/p95/p99) per config for tenant C.
Alice (runtime): baseline p50/p95/p99 = 12/48/320 ms; adaptive-batcher = 10/42/280 ms; kv-aware = 9/40/260 ms. But p99 improved only after lowering max_delay_ms 12->6.
Eva (perf): Kernel selection regression checks? Any regressions tied to selector changes?
Alice (runtime): Yes — commit abc123 changed kernel pick heuristics for attention matmul on long sequences. For seq>1024 we fell back to a safe FP32 kernel that is ~1.4x slower. GPU occupancy dropped from ~87% to ~69% for those RPCs. We reverted the selector and re-ran.
perf-bot: run 1769506789: baseline=20k rps, avg token-latency=29ms, median batch-size=6, cost-est=0.0043$/k-token. artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/sched/1769506789.tar.gz
Ben (mlinfra): Synthetic traffic tends to smooth bursts. If we want synthetic to match replay, add a bursty Poisson overlay. Synthetic alone underestimates p99 by ~2x.
Dinesh (sre): Action items: 1) pin kernel selector fallback threshold (Eva), 2) per-tenant max_delay tuning (runtime team), 3) increase KV shard allocation for high-traffic tenants (Carla), 4) add queue-depth-by-tenant metric + dashboard (me).
Carla (infra): I'll take (3) and run a small canary with tenant C config.
Eva (perf): I'll open PR to pin selector to pre-abc123 behavior and add a microbenchmark to prevent regressions.
Alice (runtime): I'll upload the tracing profile + short config snippet here and schedule a follow-up sync. Brief harness config used: ```
model: nllama-13b
replay_trace: prod_7d_multi_tenant.json
batching:
  strategy: adaptive
  max_batch_size: 32
  max_delay_ms: 6  # lowered for tail
kv_cache:
  ttl_s: 15
  per_tenant_shards: auto
kernel_selector:
  fallback_seq_threshold: 1024
  allow_quant_kernels: true
```
Alice (runtime): Logs and trace archive: s3://redwood-artifacts/sched/1769506789.tar.gz — contains nvprof, flamegraphs, and queue depth histograms.
perf-bot: summary: regression_detected=false after revert; p99 overall improved 12% on kv-aware + tuned delay.
Ben (mlinfra): Good next step — schedule a short AB test with traffic split 95/5 between baseline and kv-aware+tuned-delay to validate in prod-like conditions.
Alice (runtime): Agree. I'll coordinate and post run plan here.
